461:t_2:36.en:
$$赤木$$
「I don't know what happened to you after you parted ways with us.」

461:t_2:37.en:
$$赤木$$
「But I know who you are now. And I know you can still change from here.」

461:t_2:39.en:
$$赤木$$
「That's the first time I've seen you laugh in a long while.」

461:t_2:40.en:
$$赤木$$
「Well then, let's go get some food. Let's invite $$カヲル$$, $$レイ#pt394$$ and the others too.」

461:t_2:42.en:
$$シンジ$$
(A homeland I can never return to...)

461:t_2:43.en:
$$シンジ$$
(Will I... be able to find a new place to live my life...?)

461:t_2:47.en:
$$甲児$$
「...I see. So $$宗介$$ visited $$陣代高校$$ after the $$時空震動|lc$$...」

461:t_2:48.en:
$$風間$$
「Yeah... That's when we heard about everyone in the Volunteer Club, too.」

461:t_2:50.en:
$$恭子$$
「Right after the incident, everyone really was angry about being deceived...」

461:t_2:51.en:
$$風間$$
「But as time passed and we calmed down, we ended up worrying about everyone more than being angry.」

461:t_2:52.en:
$$詩織$$
「And we've come to understand that Earth is in real trouble, after all.」

461:t_2:53.en:
$$風間$$
「So all of you have been fighting through all of that, haven't you.」

461:t_2:54.en:
$n
「Even so, it doesn't change the fact that I deceived my friends...」

461:t_2:57.en:
$$小野Ｄ$$
「...That's not like you guys, acting like that.」

461:t_2:59.en:
$$小野Ｄ$$
「You deceiving us is squared away by the fact that you're fighting to protect us.」

461:t_2:63.en:
$$小野Ｄ$$
「But... there's nothing we can do about it, is there.」

461:t_2:67.en:
$n
「But... if I'm allowed, I want to bring peace back and return to $$陣代高校$$...」

461:t_2:69.en:
$$恭子$$
「$$小野Ｄ$$...! You don't have to put it like that...」

461:t_2:70.en:
$$小野Ｄ$$
「What's this 'allowed' or 'not allowed' business? Students coming to school is only natural, isn't it?」

461:t_2:72.en:
$$小野Ｄ$$
「Tell $$相良$$ and $$アルト$$ and the others too. Tell them that I... precisely because the world is like this, want all of Class 2-4 to graduate together.」

461:t_2:73.en:
$$詩織$$
「Please tell $$カレン$$ and $$さやか$$ and the others too.」

461:t_2:75.en:
$$恭子$$
「$l... Your smile has become natural.」

461:t_2:76.en:
$$風間$$
「You're right. When we first met, you were almost scary.」

461:t_2:78.en:
$n
「The next time I come to see you all, I'll bring $$千鳥$$, $$宗介$$ and Miss $$スズネ$$ with me... I'll do everything I can to make that happen.」

461:t_2:81.en:
$$詩織$$
「Isn't there anything we can do...?」

461:t_2:82.en:
$$小野Ｄ$$
「...Is waiting all we can do...?」

461:t_2:83.en:
$$風間$$
「But... I think we can at least cheer them on...」

461:t_10:5.en:
$$正太郎$$
「$$万丈$$... Are humans really such a bad kind of creature?」

461:t_10:7.en:
$$正太郎$$
「$$ワッ太$$ and $$勝平$$ believe humans are wonderful, but I've seen so many villains up until now.」

461:t_10:8.en:
$$正太郎$$
「People who deceive others for their own desires, people who take others' lives without a second thought to get what they want... So...」

461:t_10:9.en:
$$万丈$$
「But you believe in humans. That's why you can fight with $$鉄人$$.」

461:t_10:11.en:
$$万丈$$
「Able to become good or evil... Humans and $$鉄人$$ are the same.」

461:t_10:12.en:
$$万丈$$
「Where $$鉄人$$ has a remote control, humans have a will. That is what decides how a person lives.」

461:t_10:13.en:
$$正太郎$$
「Do you believe in humans too, $$万丈$$?」

461:t_10:14.en:
$$万丈$$
「...Sadly, I've gotten a little tainted. So I can't say the word 'believe' so easily.」

461:t_10:15.en:
$$万丈$$
「But I think of humans as good people and bad people all lumped together. I have no intention of obeying a machine that would lump them all into one and destroy them.」

461:t_10:16.en:
$$正太郎$$
「Thank you, $$万丈$$. I feel a little... better.」

461:t_10:17.en:
$$万丈$$
「Rely on an adult once in a while, $$正太郎$$. I do like to think I have at least that much dependability in me.」

461:t_10:19.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
(That strong light didn't lose even to the words of the $$コンピュータードール#pilot$$, and it produced $$Ｚチップ$$ for us.)

461:t_10:20.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
(That amount... 100 Z. I'll add this to the unit's stock.)

461:t_10:21.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
(Moonlight illuminates the darkness, but as for the sun, where will it lead humanity, I wonder...)

461:t_10:26.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Good work, $$赤木$$. That was quite a lot of trouble this time.」

461:t_10:27.en:
$$赤木$$
「I hadn't paid much attention to it till now, but when hitting the budget is directly on the line, it really gets the nerves going.」

461:t_10:28.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「That attitude is exactly the arrogance of a big corporation.」

461:t_10:30.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Look at $$竹尾ゼネラルカンパニー$$. The President, Executive Director and Managing Director are all always fighting tooth and nail for profit, aren't they?」

461:t_10:31.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Being a champion of justice is all well and good, but as long as you're a member of a company, you must pursue profit far more strictly.」

461:t_10:33.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I won't accept excuses! Besides, if $$２１世紀警備保障$$ went bankrupt, $$ダイ・ガード$$ would become unusable too!」

461:t_10:34.en:
$$赤木$$
「I can't have that, not in the current situation!」

461:t_10:35.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「To reform that lack of cost awareness, I will subject you, $$赤木$$, to the same program as $$ＤＥＭ$$'s new employee training.」

461:t_10:36.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「One! New employees use their bodies! One! New employees take the initiative and speak up!」
